title: Rhythm Canvas
summary: A browser-native rhythm visualizer: load a local audio loop, pick a visual mode and tap accents on the beat.

cover.alt: Pulse mode on a black-navy Swiss poster: a central dial with a red beat-progress arc and white step ticks, expanding rings from the last beats, and three lime tap-accent rings where the user tapped the stage; compact mode and transport rails below.

desktop.alt: Orbit mode at desktop size: beat nodes parked on concentric hairline orbits with a red sweep line one lap per bar, the newest downbeat node in signal red, warm-white center marker, and the transport rail with the Night Signal loop at 96 BPM.

tablet.alt: Type mode at tablet size: a giant condensed word from the loop's token list fills the navy stage in warm-white display type over a faint row of live spectrum bars, with the red beat numeral at lower right and the mode and transport rails along the bottom.

mobile.alt: The same Type-mode poster on a 390px phone: the giant word scales down but keeps full-bleed stage presence; mode buttons sit above the transport with the progress rail on its own full-width row and 48px touch targets.
